Title: General availability: Stream Analytics no-code editor updates in Feb 2023

Body.Content:
The Stream Analytics no-code editor enables you to develop a Stream Analytics job without writing a single line of code. You can quickly develop jobs to handle a variety of scenarios in just a few minutes. This month, a few new capabilities have been released, including: the Power BI output support, and the data preview improvement.

The Power BI output feature in no-code editor allows you to create the real-time dashboard in Power BI without requiring a separate database for caching the data produced from Stream Analytics jobs. It simplifies the creation process and reduces the cost.

To learn more, see No-code stream processing through Azure Stream Analytics | Microsoft Learns, and Build real-time dashboard with Power BI dataset produced from Stream Analytics no code editor | Microsoft Learn
